text: 商务部外国投资管理司司长孟华婷在新闻发布会上表示，下半年，将继续围绕利用外资固稳促优目标，进一步塑造吸引外资新优势，做好扩增量、稳存量、提质量各项工作。在扩增量方面，将继续实施高水平对外开放，稳妥有序深化增值电信、生物技术、外商独资医院和职业技能培训机构等领域的开放试点，支持北京市提升国家服务业综合示范区建设水平，还将加快修订出台关于外国投资者并购境内企业的规定。将持续打造“投资中国”品牌，精心设计一系列投资促进活动。中国国际投资贸易洽谈会是“投资中国”的标志性展会，今年将举办第26届，欢迎跨国公司积极参展参会。（证券时报）
text_en: Meng Huating, Director of the Foreign Investment Administration Department of the Ministry of Commerce, said at a press conference that in the second half of the year, the focus will continue to be on stabilizing and optimizing foreign capital utilization, creating new advantages for attracting foreign investment, and working on expanding increment, maintaining stock, and improving quality. For expanding increment, China will continue to implement high-level opening-up, cautiously and orderly deepen pilot openings in fields such as value-added telecom, biotechnology, wholly foreign-owned hospitals, and vocational training institutions, support Beijing in improving the construction level of the National Comprehensive Service Industry Demonstration Zone, and accelerate the revision and issuance of regulations on foreign investors' acquisition of domestic enterprises. It will continue to build the 'Invest in China' brand and carefully design investment promotion activities. The China International Fair for Investment & Trade is a flagship event for 'Invest in China', and this year will be the 26th edition, welcoming multinational companies to actively participate. (Securities Times)
